title: Chess, But I Can Use Minecraft Blocks
summary: Minecraft chess vs Stockfish (Fairy-Stockfish). The player has an inventory of Minecraft blocks: 3 cobblestone blocks (permanent blockades), 1 TNT (explodes a 3x3 area, removing every piece except kings), and 1 chest (placed on a square; a piece inside it is hidden and cannot be captured). Placing a block uses the player's turn and blocks can't be moved later. Game 1 he wins quickly using TNT on c7; game 2 he wastes the TNT on move 1 and plays with cobble + chest; final game checkmates with only one chest.
rules: Standard chess start; player White vs Stockfish (Fairy-Stockfish, 3600).
Inventory: Cobblestone x3, TNT x1, Chest x1 (thumbnail/frames show cobble x2 + TNT x1 + chest x1 mid-game).
Instead of a move, the player may place one block from inventory on an empty square (TNT may target an occupied square; its centre was placed on c7 among pieces).
Cobblestone: impassable wall for all pieces, permanent.
TNT: immediately explodes a 3x3 area centred on its square, removing all pieces there except kings (kings are immune).
Chest: placed on an empty square; a piece that moves into the chest is protected (cannot be captured while inside) but still attacks/gives check; it can later move out.
Only the player has blocks; the engine has none.
win_condition: Checkmate Stockfish (variants of challenge: with all blocks; without TNT; with only one chest).
